# LOKF Registrar

> Validate the Linked Open Knowledge Format (LOKF) semantic layer on top of OKF v0.2 in Obsidian.

## Agent context

If `.lokf/knowledge/index.md` exists in this repository, read it first - it
is a queryable [LOKF](https://lokf.nolan-nichols.com) knowledge bundle with
repository-specific context, conventions, and typed relationships that plain
prose can't express. A concept marked `status: draft` has not yet been
confirmed by a person; one with a `human:` entry under `verified` has - weigh
them accordingly. The `lokf-docent` skill, if installed, is the disciplined
way to answer from the bundle - and to record what it lacked.
